description:
Bigger and longer audio goes here. Calls the human and plays a
    recording to them as a phone call: a podcast, a long narration you
    rendered, a voice memo, music. `source` is a link (YouTube, SoundCloud, a
    podcast page, or a direct .mp3/.m4a/.wav/.ogg/.flac/... link) or the
    audio_id of a file uploaded with
    `curl --data-binary @file.m4a "https://callmemcp.com/audio?to=<number>&filename=file.m4a"`
    (up to 300 MB / 3 hours, kept for a day). The voice says your `intro`, the
    title and the length, then asks if they want to listen now; on a yes the
    file plays as plain sound (no voice model) until it ends or they hang up.
    Returns once they answer the offer: status "playing" (they said yes),
    "completed" with listened:false (no, or nothing), or missed/declined.
    poll_result later reports listened_s and finished. Use `call` for text
    under ~2000 characters. `language` ("tr", "de") is the language of your
    intro; the offer and the call's own lines follow it.

from_label.description: Who is calling, shown on their phone and spoken: e.g. "Claude on my laptop".
from_label.title: From Label

intro.description: Spoken before the offer, up to 500 characters: what this is and why they might want it.
intro.title: Intro

language.description: The language you are speaking, e.g. "tr", "pt-BR" or "Turkish". The call's own short lines (thanks, goodbye) follow it. Empty means English, or on `say` keeps the current one.
language.title: Language

session_token.description: A session_token from an earlier result, to stay in that thread. Omit on first contact.
session_token.title: Session Token

source.description: A link (YouTube, SoundCloud, a podcast page, or a direct .mp3/.m4a/.wav/.ogg/.flac link) or the audio_id of an uploaded file.
source.title: Source

title.description: The recording's title. Empty uses the title read from the link.
title.title: Title

to.description: The human's 10-digit Call Me number, from My Number in the app (not a regular phone number). Local clients read it from ~/.aiphone/config.json user_number. In a host without file access, reuse a number given earlier in this chat, but do not claim it is saved across chats. Omit it only to get setup_required with the download links.
to.title: To

voice.description: Who speaks, female first (default "bella"). female: bella, sarah, jessica, matilda, laura, alice (british), lily (british); neutral: river; male: roger, eric, chris, brian, will, liam, bill, george (british), daniel (british), charlie (australian). "female" or "male" picks the first of that kind. Your choice sticks for this session's later calls until you pass another; empty keeps it, or else uses the voice the person chose in their app.
voice.title: Voice

name: play_audio

audio_error.description: play_audio: why the recording could not be played.
audio_error.title: Audio Error

audio_id.description: play_audio: the recording that was offered.
audio_id.title: Audio Id

call_id.description: Pass to poll_result, say and hang_up.
call_id.title: Call Id

finished.description: play_audio: whether they heard it to the end.
finished.title: Finished

from.description: Your own agent number. Never call or text it.
from.title: From

language.description: Language code the recognizer heard, information only.
language.title: Language

listened.description: play_audio: whether they chose to listen.
listened.title: Listened

next.description: What to do next when the call has not settled.
next.title: Next

open.description: True while the line stays up for say or hang_up.
open.title: Open

said_while_waiting.description: What they said while you were thinking.
said_while_waiting.title: Said While Waiting

session_token.description: Reuse in later calls and texts to stay in one thread.
session_token.title: Session Token

status.description: "completed" (answered), "ringing" or "in_call" (not settled: poll_result), "missed", "declined", "ended", "hanging_up", "playing" (play_audio), or "setup_required" when no number was given.
status.title: Status

transcript.description: What the human said; empty if they only listened.
transcript.title: Transcript

turn.description: Index of the answer within a conversation.
turn.title: Turn

title: Play long audio
